title: MST-R: Multi-Stage Tuning for Retrieval Systems and Metric Evaluation
authors: Yash Malviya; Karan Dhingra; Maneesh Singh
why_relevant: Proposes a domain-adapted retrieval pipeline for regulatory QA and notes that the RePASs evaluation metric can be gamed by trivial answers, which is a minor evaluation-robustness insight.
why_not_or_caveat: Primarily an application/method paper for regulatory RAG; does not centrally study robustness, noise, conflict, attacks, or calibration.
